title: Liquid Veil
description: A slow translucent liquid or mist veil that moves across one dominant source image without replacing it.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Veil strength while the source remains dominant.

parameters.label: Veil Size
parameters.description: Scale of the coherent liquid forms.
